title: ThrowableTorches
description: Throw your torches! Left‑click to hurl a torch that arcs through the air and sticks wherever it lands.
body:
[![JOIN OUR DISCORD](https://img.shields.io/badge/JOIN%20OUR%20DISCORD-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/HTkn94BXmA)

Lets you **throw your torches** instead of placing them one block at a time. Hold a torch and left-click — it flies through the air in a realistic arc, trailing flame and smoke, and sticks to the first surface it hits. Great for instantly lighting caves, ravines, high ledges, and dark corners without walking over to place every torch by hand.

![throwing torches](https://i.ibb.co/Md8g51s/Minecraft-Neo-Forge-1-21-1-Singleplayer2026-06-2114-12-16online-video-cutter-com-ezgif-com-optimize.gif)

**Please report any bugs, errors, or feature suggestions on Discord:** [https://discord.gg/4XUPywnEyE](https://discord.gg/4XUPywnEyE)

> 🎮 **Singleplayer note:** Works perfectly in singleplayer — just drop it into your mods folder as usual.
>
> 📦 **Multiplayer:** Install it on **both the server and the client**. The client detects your left-click; the server throws the torch and sticks it where it lands.
>
> ⚙️ **Zero configuration** — no config files, no commands, no keybinds to set up. It works the moment you install it.

How it works:
- **Throw a torch**: Hold any torch and left-click to launch it. It flies in a real arc with an arm swing and a glowing flame + smoke trail.
- **Aim anywhere**: Point at a wall, the floor, or just open air — you don't have to be looking at a block for it to throw.
- **It sticks where it lands**: A standing torch on top faces, a wall torch on the sides — placed automatically wherever the torch comes to rest.
- **Never waste a torch**: If it can't be placed where it landed (or it hits a mob), it simply drops as an item to pick back up.
- **Every torch type**: Works with regular torches, soul torches, and redstone torches — each one trails its own particle as it flies.
- **Survival-balanced**: One torch is consumed per throw in survival (free in creative), and throwing is rate-limited so a held button can't empty your stack in an instant.
